title: Build one scoped orchestration ticket to a green make test
why: Prevents a builder seat from reporting workflow machinery as done when make test in claude/workflow was never run on the tree it committed. make test is the one definition: schema, shellcheck, herdr-first lint and the watcher suites, all in Podman.

trigger.condition: The orchestrator hands a builder seat one scoped orchestration ticket - architect model chain, failover watcher, test-plan block - with its test plan written in the brief.

gates.why: Schema, shellcheck, herdr-first lint and every watcher suite, in the pinned Podman image. A seat that runs a subset has proven the subset.

exit.condition: The ticket test plan passes, make test is green in Podman, and the work is committed on the seat branch with a message that names what the tests proved.

on_failure.action: Fix the cause and rerun the suite. Never report the ticket done on a red suite.

on_failure.case: three consecutive red runs on the same case
on_failure.action: Stop, write the failing case and its output to the handoff, and report blocked. Do not weaken the case to make it pass.
Report the environment fault. Never fall back to running the suite on the host (Rule 14).

on_failure.case: the ticket needs a file outside allowed_paths
on_failure.action: Stop and ask the orchestrator. The write boundary is what keeps two seats off the same file.
